heading_path: Buyer's Guide Cancel or reissue a solicitation - How to cancel a solicitation
Buyer's Guide
blocks.markdown: How to cancel a solicitation If a solicitation is cancelled before the closing date, you must: issue a cancellation notice on the Government Electronic Tendering Service (GETS), which will mark the notice of proposed procurement (NPP) as ‘cancelled’ on GETS notify the Offer Receiving Unit (ORU) of the cancellation and provide disposal instructions for any responses to the original solicitation If a solicitation is cancelled after the closing date, you should inform businesses within 10 calendar days of the cancellation.
